messages:
mia: quick sync — we need to lock the eval-sample curation for the FP8->INT4 rollout today. main asks: sample size, stratification axes, and snapshot cadence.
sanjay: agreed. my naive take: 10k samples stratified by prompt type (instr, convo, code, summarization) + difficulty buckets.
leo: 10k seems heavy for nightly re-eval. can we do 2 tiers? small daily smoke (1k) + full weekly (10k).
mia: +1 to tiering. daily smoke should cover headwise-sensitive prompts and long-tail high-impact cases.
tara: proposal: define 4 axes: prompt_type, length_bucket, head_sensitivity_score, recent_regression_flag. use stratified sampling over their cross-product but cap per-cell to avoid huge |cells| explosion.
sanjay: how do we compute head_sensitivity_score reliably? we have previous per-head degradation metrics but noisy. maybe use median absolute log-loss increase across last 3 canaries.
leo: sounding good. implementation detail: we should preserve original distribution weighting for production like queries (95th token length skew) — otherwise the eval won't reflect customer exposure. so stratify but reweight when computing aggregate metrics.
mia: reweighting is fine. another tradeoff: should shadow sampling (live traffic snapshots) feed the pool for weekly eval? ops-bot: shadow-snapshots: job completed 1720012400, 5000 raw candidates (anonymized).
tara: yes feed them but scrub PII and remove low-info queries (e.g., single token, repeated pings). also tag snapshots by endpoint to allow per-customer sensitivity checks.
sanjay: sampling budget question: weekly full 10k from pool + 1k synthetic edge cases (constructed adversarial prompts) to stress quantization-sensitive behaviors.
leo: synthetic cases are important for headwise failures — but make sure we annotate which are synthetic for metric dashboards.
mia: final call on cadence: daily smoke (1k) from recent 24h shadow-snapshots + weekly full (10k) mixing 70% snapshot / 30% historical curated + 1k synthetic.
tara: agree. need checklist for data infra: anonymize, bucketize head scores, compute weights, produce JSONL with metadata tags (prompt_type,length_bucket,head_score,synthetic_flag,endpt_tag).
sanjay: regression gating thresholds? if weekly avg BLEU/ROUGE drop > X or degscore delta > Y then block rollout. need explicit numbers.
leo: propose temporary numbers for now: BLEU drop > 1.5 pts OR degscore regression > 0.04 triggers canary hold. we can tighten after calibration.
mia: ok. action items: tara to draft sampling SQL + anonymizer (ETA EOD), sanjay to create gating PR with provisional thresholds, leo to wire metric reweighting in eval pipeline, mia to coordinate with SRE for snapshot job ops.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: /jobs/shadow-snapshot-run at 1720012500 daily.
mia: thanks — will re-open if we need more granularity. :thumbsup:
